channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Crypto bill could reshape US rules and spark a major fight
item.description: The legislation would set rules for the crypto sector for the first time, but opponents are pushing back and the bill faces an uncertain path.

item.title: NATO jets down drone in Lithuanian airspace
item.description: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes near alliance territory would drive the organization's response.

item.title: Air pollution rose after embassy monitoring program ended
item.description: A long-running program collecting air pollution data at U.S. embassies ended in 2025. A new study suggests that led to a rise in pollution.

item.title: NASA Relocated Engineers Abruptly, Raising Concerns for Future Missions
item.description: NASA employees report losing essential equipment and staff needed for advanced spacecraft amid sudden relocations in recent weeks.
